name: RTI-352
summary: RTI-352 is a phenyltropane that is used as a radiolabeling ligand for the DAT.

pharmacology.text: RTI-352 is a phenyltropane that is used as a radiolabeling ligand for the DAT.

uses.text: RTI-352 is a phenyltropane that is used as a radiolabeling ligand for the DAT.

fact.en: RTI-352 is used as a radiolabelled ligand, a version carrying a radioactive atom so that scanners can see where dopamine transporters are.
fact.zh: RTI-352 被用作放射性標記配體，也就是帶有放射性原子的版本，讓掃描儀能看出多巴胺轉運蛋白的位置。
fact.zhHans: RTI-352 被用作放射性标记配体，也就是带有放射性原子的版本，让扫描仪能看出多巴胺转运蛋白的位置。
